qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | assistant hostel superintendent (residential post): A postgraduate degree in any discipline. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in the fields of social work, community guidance, counseling, or skill development. Experience of at least two years working in a Government/Semi-government organization. Knowledge of Marathi & English language essential. Knowledge of computer is essential.

salary_details.details: The posts are filled on a purely contractual basis for 06 months on fixed honorarium.

how_to_apply: Prepare your application on a plain paper indicating the name, address, contact number, educational qualifications, experience, etc. for the post applied for.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates to your application.
Submit the application to the Office of the Registrar, S.N.D.T. Women's University, 1, Nathibai Damodar Thackersey Road, Churchgate Campus, Mumbai - 400 020.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 15-10-2026 up to 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: SNDT Women's University has invited applications for the post of Assistant Hostel Superintendent (Residential Post).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 04 vacancies available across Churchgate, Juhu, and Pune Campuses.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 15-10-2026 up to 05:00 p.m.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates require a postgraduate degree in any discipline, knowledge of Marathi and English, and knowledge of computer. Experience of at least two years in a Government/Semi-government organization is required, with preference for social work, community guidance, counseling, or skill development experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for general category candidates?
faq.answer: The age limit is not less than 18 years and not more than 40 years for persons belonging to the General Category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for backward classes?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not more than 45 years for persons belonging to Backward Classes.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed honorarium of Rs. 30,000/- per month for a period of 06 months.

faq.question: Q8. How should candidates apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply on a plain paper along with self-attested copies of certificates submitted to the Office of the Registrar at the Churchgate Campus.
